name: Safari fraudulent website warning enforced
description: Web filtering. Safari has no enhanced tier, so the warning is the most it can enforce, and it has to come from a configuration profile. The user's own setting sits in Safari's sandbox container, which the agent cannot read without Full Disk Access.
query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.Safari.plist' AND key = 'WarnAboutFraudulentWebsites' UNION ALL SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path LIKE '/Library/Managed Preferences/%/com.apple.Safari.plist' AND key = 'WarnAboutFraudulentWebsites')) AS enforced, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.Safari.plist' AND key = 'WarnAboutFraudulentWebsites' UNION ALL SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path LIKE '/Library/Managed Preferences/%/com.apple.Safari.plist' AND key = 'WarnAboutFraudulentWebsites') WHERE value NOT IN ('1', 'true')) AS switched_off;
